nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: What phenomenon is supported by the reported observations?

nodes.title: Choose instrument and selection
nodes.body: A search for the Standard Model Higgs boson in proton-proton collisions with the ATLAS detector at the LHC is presented.

nodes.title: Acquire and analyze observations
nodes.body: The datasets used correspond to integrated luminosities of approximately 4.8 fb^-1 collected at sqrt(s) = 7 TeV in 2011 and 5.8 fb^-1 at sqrt(s) = 8 TeV in 2012.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Clear evidence for the production of a neutral boson with a measured mass of 126.0 +/- 0.4(stat) +/- 0.4(sys) GeV is presented.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: This observation, which has a significance of 5.9 standard deviations, corresponding to a background fluctuation probability of 1.7x10^-9, is compatible with the production and decay of the Standard Model Higgs boson.
